text_block_list.text:
Ever since our patrol around town with Hokko Tarumae,
the two of us have been brainstorming ideas
for revitalizing the community.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...The number of visitors is growing.
It might be time to unveil it to everyone in the hot spring resort as well."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Our—"Spa Town Revitalization Project"!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—All kinds of shops selling onsen manju and more.
The footbath that once stood at the town's entrance. The revival of what once belonged to this town.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Furthermore—enriching our new content so active Umamusume and other race-related guests can enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Reviving the old town and introducing a fresh breeze.
That is the overview of our plan.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see! You mean selling unique, onsen town-exclusive racing merch at souvenir shops?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it looks like you've come up with various other ideas
for renewing the eatery to target Umamusume customers.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—I'll do my absolute best.
So please... won't everyone lend me your support!?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Hmm. What do the rest of you think?

text_block_list.name: Hot Springs Town Locals
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, what? This is gonna be a massive job!
Which means it'll be just as rewarding!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank you very much! Everyone!

And so, with the help of everyone in the hot spring town,
the plan got underway—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh! The onsen manju shop is open!
It was closed when I came by the other day, though...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, aren't there more shops now?
I hear that souvenir shop over there
even sells original hot spring ear accessories.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That one's "Recommended for Active Umamusume!
Post-Bath Stamina Set Meal"...?! 
Ooh~! Wanna stop by for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, the footbath feels so good~...
It really soaks in after walking around so much~...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Alright. It's getting dark, so isn't it about time?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Hit the lights, please!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Look, look at that street over there!
There's a whole bunch of lanterns glowing whoosh-like!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Something's drawn here...?
Is that—an Umamusume!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing! It feels like we're racing inside a lantern!
It's kind of magical~...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The customers' reactions are great too!
People are already writing online reviews
about the renovation—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Um. Now that it's come to this, I can't help thinking.
It worked well as a revamp, but—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Still... it's not like the town was revived exactly as it used to be. ...How does this sight look to the locals, I wonder."

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
What're you worrying about?
It's fine, really.

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Look, the town's lively again—
Brings back memories. Really takes me back.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!?
But the scenery has changed—

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
Well, everything can't just stay the same forever.
And that's fine.
A town is shaped by the people living in it, after all.

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. New things getting started, new people
gathering together... That's what makes the town
really feel "alive."

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks a million.
Tarumae-chan. Trainer-san."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
N-Not at all, not at all!
Thank YOU so much!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'll... give it my all even more!
For the sake of this town!
